Lirael: a 23-year-old male drow sorcerer, slender, dark grey-blue skin, short white hair, black Sentinel coat.
Brand: a 150-year-old male dwarf artificer: short, stocky and broad like every dwarf, spry, with a long grey-white beard and wild grey hair, in a brass-and-steel power armor suit with a glowing holy core.
Sazed: a male shifter of about 45, a lean monk with a quarterstaff, always fully dressed in his black covert ops suit (long sleeves, high collar, never shirtless). A shifter is a very hairy man: an ordinary human face and build, just lithe, with normal human ears. Not a wolf, beast or werewolf, nothing animal about him, and not an elf. Sazed has wild, swept-back dark reddish-brown hair, heavy sideburns running into a rough beard, hairy hands and wrists, yellow-green eyes behind small round spectacles.
